text:
deploy-bot: Rollout finished for release v2026.03.21 -> us-west-1 (canary 15%). Starting post-deploy smoke suite: smoke/http, smoke/kv-warmup, smoke/embed-synth. Notifying eng-releases channel.

olivia: seeing p95 regression on smoke/kv-warmup from ~320ms -> ~1.1s on two canary replicas (host-17, host-19). No errors in HTTP, just latency.

garret: which host logs look noisy? can you paste a sample?

olivia: log tail from host-17: ```
[2026-03-21T18:12:03Z] kv-warmup: prefix=abcde... len=768 hit=false duration=1120ms
[2026-03-21T18:12:06Z] kv-warmup: prefix=fghij... len=640 hit=false duration=1078ms
```

anita: synth probe (embed) saw a short 429 blip around the same time for requests with long prefixes. Not widespread, but correlates with kv warm misses.

leo: what's our automatic roll threshold? last I recall: 3 hosts failing OR canary failure rate >20% for 5m.

olivia: current deployment gate config: p95 > 800ms on >=2 canary hosts for 3 consecutive mins triggers hold/alert but not automatic rollback. Auto-rollback only for >30% error rate.

garret: proposal: instead of full rollback, open a deployment circuit for canary traffic and reroute canary -> quantized-compat variant (quant-v1) that has smaller mem working set. That preserves production capacity while we triage root cause.

anita: +1. Quant variant has slightly lower quality but should avoid warmup kv thrash. We'll label it as temporary fallback in release notes.

mike: I'm ok with a temporary fallback if we keep traffic at 15% and extend canary watch to 30m.

deploy-bot: executing reroute: `/deploybot reroute --env us-west-1 --from canary --to model:quant-v1 --percent 15 --reason "kv-warmup p95 spike"`

qa-bot: synthetic re-run queued against quant-v1 now (run id: synth-3087654321). Expect results in ~90s.

olivia: realtime after reroute: host-17 p95 dropped to 340ms, host-19 to 310ms. synth embed re-run shows no 429s.

garret: capturing metrics, creating followup ticket INF-7422: kv-prefix-cache entropy correlation + longer prefix workload regression. Adding traces and host dumps.

anita: I'll add a targeted synthetic that exercises prefixes >512 and a KV warmup stress test for the next CI run.

leo: note for release notes: "Temporary canary fallback to quant-v1 in us-west-1 due to kv-warmup latency; no rollback performed. Investigating prefix-cache behavior with long-context workloads."

mike: :thumbsup: leaving canary at 15% and extended watch. If we see any re-escalation -> hold and reconvene.

deploy-bot: Canaries stable at 15% with fallback in place. Auto-rollback remains disabled. Closing thread unless any objections.

olivia: no objections, will post a follow-up once INF-7422 has the initial triage notes.

garret: thanks team — will pull telemetry dashboards into the ticket.

anita: assigning myself as lead on the followup.

leo: marking this discussion for the release notes / postmortem doc.
